title: Technical Deflation in Vermont: A Policy and Economic Framework
summary: A comprehensive review of technical deflationary trends within Vermont's AHS infrastructure. This report details the economic shift from volume-based legacy IT expenditures to value-based data liquidity platforms.

children.text: The transition toward a value-based technological model requires a fundamental understanding of technical deflation. As the cost of data exchange drops, the value of the insights derived from that data increases exponentially.
True digital transformation occurs when the cost of knowing a patient's history drops to near zero.

body.caption: Visualizing the shift from legacy silos to liquidity fabrics.
